pkgmetadata.longdescription: Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic coding CLI, as the prebuilt native linux-x64 binary from Anthropic's release endpoint (downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases), the same file upstream's install.sh downloads and verifies against the release's manifest.json. Installed as /opt/claude-code/bin/claude with a /usr/bin/claude symlink. Versions follow upstream's stable channel; the ebuild pins the version, so update by upgrading the package, not with 'claude update'.
